authentication_notes: Registration and verification endpoints (/user-registrations, /verify-code, /resend-code) do not require authentication.
/categories is public; all other endpoints are protected.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.

risks: Ambiguity in role-based access control: endpoints like /tech_officer/reports imply specific roles but do not define how role membership is enforced beyond auth_required.
No explicit cleanup or deactivation endpoints for users, operators, or reports.
/reports/map/accepted lacks a clear definition of 'accepted' state transition criteria.
External maintainer assignment depends on an implicit workflow (tech officer acceptance) not documented in endpoint descriptions.
